title: Delegates, events, and lambdas (callbacks and extensions)
summary: Learn how C# turns methods into typed callbacks using delegates, Func, and Action. Lambdas and local functions let you write inline handlers; events protect the subscription list from outsiders. C# 14 extension members add properties and static-looking helpers on types you do not own. Compare throughout with JavaScript first-class functions and EventTarget.
